text: Sports science is an interdisciplinary subject centered on the laws of human movement, functional regulation and health promotion. It integrates knowledge from biology, medicine, engineering, psychology and other fields, aiming to cultivate professional talents with the ability to conduct scientific analysis of the human body in sports, design sports intervention plans and manage sports health. The professional objective is to enable students to master the full chain of knowledge from the optimization of competitive sports training to public health management, and to be able to exert professional value in scenarios such as improving sports performance, preventing sports injuries, and intervening in chronic diseases through sports.
